description: North American SNJ-4 Texan 0442/4-G-75 (c/n 88-11825), preserved at the museum since retirement in 1970; mounted on an outdoor pedestal.
Grumman F9F-2B Panther 0453 (BuNo 127171), served as 3-A-123, 3-A-119 (made the only Argentine Panther carrier landing, 27 July 1963) and finally 3-A-118; retired 1970 and displayed outdoors.

A-4B Skyhawk displayed as 0667/3-A-312 (c/n 12178) representing the aircraft from which Lt J. Arca ejected on 21 May 1982; a hybrid airframe carrying BuNo 145050 and ARA 25 de Mayo titles with two ship-kill marks. Outdoors.
aliases: Skyhawk; A-4Q; A4Q; 0667; BuNo 145050; c/n 12178; A4; A4B
